name: llama.cpp

tested.machine: Colab free runtime, Tesla T4 (15 GB), CUDA 13.0, llama.cpp build 23deec0
tested.result: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct Q5_K_M (1.19 GiB). GPU (ngl 99): pp512 4635 t/s, tg128 136.6 t/s. ngl 0 run: pp512 1492 t/s (likely GPU-assisted), tg128 5.96 t/s. Single run each; CUDA build took 550 s. Second model, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Q4_K_M (4.36 GiB), GPU ngl 99: pp512 1355 t/s, tg128 36.3 t/s (tuner predicted about 36).

notes: Planned core of the local helper.

name: Ollama
notes: Easy model serving; has a Jetson tutorial.

name: vLLM
notes: High-throughput serving; expects an Nvidia GPU.

name: SGLang
notes: Reuses code from other projects with their own terms.

name: TensorRT-LLM
license: Apache-2.0 (per repo label; third-party notices not reviewed)
notes: Nvidia-optimized; FP4 support targets newer chips. Likely 'not free' in our labels.

name: WebLLM / MLC
license: Apache-2.0 (web-llm repo only; MLC-LLM not checked)

tested.result: SmolLM2-135M ran at 5.5 then 9.3 tok/s; 1B model blocked by Hugging Face 429 rate limit

notes: Core of the in-browser tier.

name: Unsloth
license: Apache-2.0 core; AGPL-3.0 optional parts (e.g. Studio UI)
notes: Candidate for free-GPU QLoRA notebooks. Use the core package only.

name: NVIDIA NeMo
notes: Training framework, mainly for larger setups.

name: Open WebUI
notes: Check its license terms before bundling anything. Do not bundle or rebrand without reading the full license.

name: ComfyUI
notes: Copyleft: do not bundle; link to upstream or install in the user's own notebook.

name: whisper / faster-whisper
license: MIT (whisper code and weights; faster-whisper also MIT)
notes: Browser version to be tested.

name: piper
notes: Text to speech. Copyleft: do not bundle. Repo page asks for maintainers.

name: Segment Anything / NanoSAM
license: Apache-2.0 (code); SA-1B dataset has a separate research license; NanoSAM not checked
notes: NanoSAM is the TensorRT variant for Jetson.

name: NanoOWL
license: not stated on the page I read
notes: Needs a Jetson Orin with TensorRT.

name: jetson-inference
notes: Needs a Jetson dev kit, TensorRT, and JetPack.

name: PhysX
notes: C++ SDK. Whether a web build is practical is unchecked.

name: OpenUSD Exchange SDK
notes: Authoring consistent USD scenes.

name: Isaac Lab
notes: Isaac Sim code is Apache-2.0 but needs the Kit SDK and assets under separate NVIDIA terms.

name: Cosmos 3 Edge (4B)
notes: Described as running on RTX, DGX and Jetson. Not checked on free hardware.

name: BitNet (bitnet.cpp)
notes: 1-bit models on CPU and GPU. Speedup and energy figures are the project's own claims, untested here. Candidate for the weak-hardware CPU tier.

name: ONNX Runtime GenAI
notes: Runs Phi, Qwen, Llama, Gemma, gpt-oss and Whisper. Backends include CPU, CUDA, DirectML and WebGPU. DirectML may suit Windows AMD iGPUs (untested).

name: MarkItDown
notes: Converts PDF, Office files and more to Markdown for document Q&A. Python only.

name: Transformers.js
notes: Detection, segmentation, speech and embeddings in the browser. WebGPU optional (experimental in many browsers).

name: wllama
notes: llama.cpp in WebAssembly. Files limited to 2 GB, so split models (chunks of 512 MB or less). WebGPU optional.

name: exo
notes: Pools devices to run bigger models. Mac GPU; Linux CPU only per its README; Windows not mentioned.
